answer: Reputation-Coupled Task Escrow. New identities start on a low-value meadow of micro-tasks, and each payout is escrowed until a randomly chosen peer confirms delivery. Payment splits release only after three independent confirmations, so a clone farm must seed real work and hold capital idle per identity. The confirmation ratio rises sharply past a small ledge, making extra clones dilute payouts. A rotating zephyr of auditors samples escrows, and any failed check forfeits the whole pending balance plus a fixed review fee, so each marginal clone carries strictly negative expected value.
